blocking.issue: The row maps KrakenD policy macros such as geoIP() to 'CEL variables'. The Configuration model defines no geo variable. Its CEL variables are request, source (ip, port, tlsVersion, clientCertSubject), route, consumer, auth, response, error, upstream, attempt, steps, ai, duration, now and self. A `source.country` variable exists only as option (c) of the open OQ-security-and-identity-14. The row relies on a variable that is not defined, which the style guide section 5 and the pack section 3 forbid.
blocking.evidence: Line 174: "Partial parity: request Phases only. Macros such as `geoIP()` map to CEL variables and `authz.geoip`". docs/architecture/02-configuration-model.md, Variables table: "`source` | `ip`, `port`, `tlsVersion`, `clientCertSubject`". docs/architecture/08-security-and-identity.md OQ-security-and-identity-14: "Should `authz.geoip` enrich upstream requests? | (a) No; (b) Header; (c) `source.country`".
blocking.fix: Replace the sentence with: "Partial parity: request Phases only. No CEL variable carries the client country, so `geoIP()` conditions become a separate `authz.geoip` Policy that stacks with `authz.cel` and cannot be combined in one expression; a `source.country` variable is option (c) of OQ-security-and-identity-14." Add the same point to the Security Policies Engine sentence of the Partial parity paragraph.

These two mechanisms name only a type that does not exist yet, and neither names the `Policy` kind that rule 4 of Method and snapshot says must carry a missing field. The JWT row does not name any kind as the carrier. It mentions `plugin` only to exclude it.
blocking.evidence: Line 148: "Gzip compression | No | Yes | Planned (M5) | A built-in compression Filter registered as a new Policy type". Line 209: "JWT token signing | Yes | Yes | Planned (M2) | A built-in signing Policy type; keys never sit in `plugin` `config`". Line 62 (rule 4): "Where a row needs a field that does not exist yet, the mechanism names the kind that would carry it and the Notes/ADR cell names the Open question."
blocking.fix: Gzip compression mechanism: "A `Policy` of a built-in compression type, not yet in the registry, running in `onResponse` on a `Route` (type per OQ-krakend-ee-parity-matrix-3, a pack section 10 amendment)".
